sentences.text: Selena Quintanilla-Pérez -LRB- -LSB- seˈlena kintaˈniʝa ˈpeɾes -RSB- or -LSB- seˈlena kintaˈniʎa ˈpeɾeθ -RSB- April 16 , 1971 -- March 31 , 1995 -RRB- was an American singer , songwriter , spokesperson , model , actress , and fashion designer .	Selena	Selena (film)

Called the Queen of Tejano music , her contributions to music and fashion made her one of the most celebrated Mexican-American entertainers of the late 20th century .	Tejano	Tejano music	Queen of Tejano music	Honorific nicknames in popular music	Mexican-American	Mexican-American	Tejano music	Tejano music
Billboard magazine named her the `` top Latin artist of the '90s '' and the `` best selling Latin artist of the decade '' .
Media outlets called her the `` Tejano Madonna '' for her clothing choices .	Tejano	Tejano music	Madonna	Madonna (entertainer)

She also ranks among the most influential Latin artists of all-time and is credited for catapulting a music genre into the mainstream market .	among the most influential Latin artists of all-time	List of people influenced by Selena	mainstream	mainstream

The youngest child of the Quintanilla family , she debuted on the music scene in 1980 as a member of the band Selena y Los Dinos , which also included her elder siblings A.B. Quintanilla and Suzette Quintanilla .	Selena y Los Dinos	Selena y Los Dinos	Suzette Quintanilla	Selena y Los Dinos#Band members	A.B. Quintanilla	A.B. Quintanilla	Selena	Selena (film)
Selena began recording professionally in 1982 .	Selena	Selena (film)
In the 1980s , she was often criticized and was refused bookings at venues across Texas for performing Tejano music -- a male-dominated music genre .	Tejano	Tejano music	Tejano music	Tejano music

However , her popularity grew after she won the Tejano Music Award for Female Vocalist of the Year in 1987 , which she won nine consecutive times .	Tejano	Tejano music	Tejano Music Award	Tejano Music Awards	Female Vocalist of the Year	Tejano Music Award for Female Vocalist of The Year

Selena signed with EMI Latin in 1989 and released her self-titled debut album the same year , while her brother became her principal music producer and songwriter .	EMI Latin	Capitol Latin	self-titled debut album	Selena (album)	Selena	Selena (film)

Selena released Entre a Mi Mundo -LRB- 1992 -RRB- , which peaked at number one on the U.S. Billboard Regional Mexican Albums chart for 19 nonconsecutive weeks .	Entre a Mi Mundo	Entre a Mi Mundo	Regional Mexican Albums	Regional Mexican Albums	Selena	Selena (film)
The album 's commercial success led music critics to call the album the `` breakthrough '' recording of her musical career .
One of its singles , `` Como La Flor '' , became one of her most popular signature songs .	Como La Flor	Como La Flor
Live !

-LRB- 1993 -RRB- won Best Mexican/American Album at the 1994 Grammy Awards , becoming the first recording by a Tejano artist to do so .	Tejano	Tejano music	Best Mexican/American Album	Grammy Award for Best Mexican/Mexican-American Album	1994 Grammy Awards	35th Grammy Awards

In 1994 , Selena released Amor Prohibido , which became one of the best-selling Latin albums in the United States .	Amor Prohibido	Amor Prohibido	best-selling Latin albums in the United States	List of best-selling Latin albums in the United States	Selena	Selena (film)

It was critically acclaimed as being responsible for Tejano music 's first marketable era as it became one of the most popular Latin music subgenres at the time .	Tejano	Tejano music	Tejano music	Tejano music	Latin music	Latin music (genre)
Selena began recording English-language songs for her crossover album .	crossover	crossover (music)	Selena	Selena (film)
Aside from music , Selena was active in her community and donated her time to civic causes .	Selena	Selena (film)
Coca-Cola appointed her its spokesperson in Texas .
Selena became a sex icon ; she was often criticized for wearing suggestive outfits in light of her comments about being a role model for young women .	Selena	Selena (film)
Selena and her guitarist , Chris Pérez , eloped in April 1992 after her father raised concerns over their relationship .	Chris Pérez	Chris Pérez	Selena	Selena (film)

On March 31 , 1995 , Selena was shot dead by Yolanda Saldívar , her friend and former employee of her Selena Etc. boutiques .	shot dead	Murder of Selena	Yolanda Saldívar	Yolanda Saldívar	Selena Etc. boutiques	Selena Etc.	Selena	Selena (film)

Saldívar was cornered by police when she attempted to flee , and threatened to kill herself , but was convinced to give herself up and was sentenced to life in prison with a possible parole after 30 years .
Saldívar is currently incarcerated at the Mountain View Unit in Gatesville , Texas .	Mountain View Unit	Mountain View Unit
Two weeks later , George W. Bush -- governor of Texas at the time -- declared Selena 's birthday Selena Day in Texas .	George W. Bush	George W. Bush	Selena	Selena (film)

Her posthumous crossover album , Dreaming of You -LRB- 1995 -RRB- , debuted atop the Billboard 200 , making Selena the first Latin artist to accomplish this feat .	crossover	crossover (music)	Dreaming of You	Dreaming of You (Selena album)	Selena	Selena (film)

, Selena has sold over 60 million albums worldwide .	Selena	Selena (film)
